Sarah Scarano

For fifteen years I sold and designed high-ticket: outdoor kitchens on show floors, three million dollars a year of them, then twenty-six historic houses I ran as rentals at ninety-six percent occupancy. I was very good at it. It was never the whole of me.

The part I loved was the sketch on the back of the brochure: the thing that did not exist yet. Three years ago I started building those things myself, in AI, automation and code. The last nine months happened in the open, and everything hanging in these rooms is live. Click any placard and you are inside the work.

Both of my companies are bootstrapped and agentic, so they need less of me every month. I am looking for a fractional, contract or advisory seat on a team building something new, in the room where the idea gets decided. The first conversation is free, and I will probably have a prototype for you by the second one.
